title: Currency display from integer cents via Intl.NumberFormat
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag cents / 100 as float money math. No arithmetic is done in floats: amounts are stored and validated as safe-integer cents (non-integers and values beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER are rejected), and the division happens exactly once, at the display boundary, as the input Intl.NumberFormat requires. Locale and currency formatting — grouping, symbol placement, fraction digits — is delegated to Intl instead of hand-rolled string code.
